ceiling_power_population.representation_basis: For signed complex int4 in [-8, 7], 128=(-8)^2+(-8)^2 is the maximum sample power; a frame mean equal to 128 is consistent with constant packed 0x88 input or saturation.
ceiling_power_population.status: candidate input-health failure pending raw-source adjudication
ceiling_power_population.required_release_action: Inspect raw sources and acquisition metadata; attach reason-coded validity; regenerate affected spectra, distributions, thresholds, rates, and downstream tables before the scientific release is frozen.

fine_designation_population.status: diagnostic survey scaffolding, not the mature per-channel fine decision
fine_designation_population.recoverability: The complete 256-bin fstat_fine array is retained for every frame, so corrected anchors and designated windows can be recomputed without rerunning the CUDA detector.
fine_designation_population.required_release_action: Estimate and validate per-channel, per-epoch anchors; reconstruct each designated window and usable null bulk from fstat_fine; do not use the archived fine_cfar or fine_detected ancillary arrays as final calibrated decisions.

interpretation: All 23 products pass their declared structural and exact-arithmetic checks. Those checks do not establish that every denominator-valid input frame is a healthy sky measurement.
